answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8356 Country: Canada Title: What is the most preferable place in one's home to perform wudhu? Question: What is the most preferable place in one's home to perform wudhu? Answer ID: 8356 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1964/1562=H/1429) A place is better which is a bit higher from where one can make wudhu facing qiblah and the splash of the water does not reach to his clothes or body. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
